name: Justice Consumer Law
verdict: Paid activity came to a complete halt in the last 7 days, with spend, leads, and CPL all dropping 100% versus the prior period, suggesting the Meta campaigns (which drove all 45 leads at $26.04 CPL over 28 days) were paused. Organic GBP engagement softened as well, down 23.4%, though GA4 sessions bucked the trend with a 71.04% lift, indicating some residual brand interest despite the paid shutdown.

performance.verdict: Campaigns paused 12 days; organic holding but intake pipeline shows zero opps.

findings.text: Meta spend hit $0 on 2026-08-06 and has stayed dark for 12 consecutive days, generating 0 leads vs. 45 leads in prior active period.
3-day signal (Aug 15–17): spend $0, leads 0 vs. prior 3 days (Aug 12–14) spend ~$0, leads 0 — shutdown fully entrenched, not a dip.
GHL pipeline shows 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments against 33 contacts in 28 days — intake leak pre-dates the pause.
GA4 sessions spiked +71% (7d) while paid is dead, including a 206-session outlier on Aug 13 — directional brand interest but source unverified (double-count caveat applies).
GBP actions dropped -23.4% (7d) and IG reach collapsed -98.76% (7d), narrowing all organic reach to near zero alongside the paid shutdown.

suggestions.text: Confirm campaign pause was intentional with client; if not, restore CROA || CBO at prior $69/day budget immediately.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend has been $0 since Aug 6 — 12 consecutive dark days — with 0 leads generated in that window versus a prior 28-day CPL of $26.04 across 45 leads. Confirm with client whether this pause was intentional (billing hold, creative review, or client-side decision). If unintentional, restore the CROA || CBO - 3/17/26 campaign at the last active daily budget of approximately $69/day. Success check: spend resumes and at least 1 lead registers within 48 hours of reactivation; verify by Aug 20.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake flow: 33 contacts with 0 opportunities created signals a form-to-pipeline disconnect, not an ads problem.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 33 contacts in the 28-day window but 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments booked, meaning no lead is progressing past contact entry. Audit the automation or manual intake step between contact creation and opportunity creation to find where records are stalling. This is an intake operations issue, not a paid media issue — resolving it is prerequisite to scaling any campaign. Success check: at least 50% of incoming leads convert to an opportunity within 7 days of fix; verify by Aug 25.

suggestions.text: Watch GA4 session spike (206 on Aug 13, +71% 7d) for source clarity before attributing to organic or any channel.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 recorded a 206-session day on Aug 13 and a 71% 7-day lift while paid was completely off — source is unknown and double-counting is a known issue for this property. No action should be taken on this number until the traffic source is verified in GA4 acquisition reports. Re-check on Aug 21 to see if the elevated baseline persists or was a one-day anomaly.
